_comment: Config for scripts/check-spec-drift.ts — see apps/backend/docs/instructions/spec-sync.instructions.md. Paths are relative to apps/backend.

endpointSwagger._ignoreRouteDirs_comment: GRANDFATHERED BASELINE: pre-existing modules with undocumented endpoints. This is a tech-debt burn-down list, NOT a permanent allowlist. The check blocks NEW undocumented endpoints; remove a dir from this list once its swagger docs are authored. Goal: empty list.

_acTraceability_comment: Check C: every backend-scoped AC-N in an FRD's acceptance-criteria table must be referenced by a test, and every AC-N in tests must exist in the FRD. outOfScopeMarkers exclude rows whose coverage column flags them as non-backend (e.g. UI-only). ignoreAcIds is a GRANDFATHERED BASELINE of pre-existing untested ACs — a burn-down list, NOT a permanent allowlist. The check blocks NEW untested backend ACs; remove an ID once its test is authored. Goal: empty ignoreAcIds.
_specStaleness_comment: Used by scripts/check-spec-stale.ts (WARN-ONLY, git-history heuristic). Counts source commits that landed since each FRD was last updated; warns when the count exceeds thresholdCommits. sourcePaths = code dirs the FRD describes; excludePaths drops the FRD's own docs dir so doc edits don't mask code drift. This is guidance, not a gate — a stale FRD may be intentional.
